idea-plugin.name: JWT Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Decode and verify JSON Web Tokens directly in the IDE. A dedicated tool window decodes the header and payload (Base64URL, not standard Base64) into two independently scrollable panels — no fixed-height table that becomes unusable once a token has more than a couple of claims.

Signature verification for HS256 (shared secret) and RS256 (public key/certificate) using only the JDK's own javax.crypto/java.security APIs — no bundled crypto library. iat/exp/nbf claims are rendered as human-readable dates with a clear expired/expiring-soon/valid indicator.

Nothing typed into the tool window is ever saved or cached between sessions — the token, secret, and key are held in memory only.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no popups.
